title: 20 Favorite Books from 20 Years of The Marginalian
author: Maria Popova
summary: It is a beautiful dream, that there is something out there to instruct you how to live — a secret handed down by your parents or your teachers, a system like liberal arts education or cognitive behavioral therapy, a slogan held up by your heroes declaring the answer to the bottomless question of why you are here. Whenever you wake up, however you wake up, you find yourself on a path no one else can walk for you, a path you must make by walking.
